name: bitops
notes: xorshift32 (three shift/xor rounds) plus a rotate and an and/or reduction. The state is a serial dependency chain, so no runtime can vectorize it — this measures scalar integer issue rate. VL's `>>>` is the logical shift and `rotl` is an intrinsic; JS and Python have no rotate primitive and spell it as two shifts and an or (idiomatic for those languages).
